article.story: RICHMOND, Va. -- — Joe Bamisile totaled 23 points and 11 rebounds to power VCU to a 66-47 victory over Pennsylvania on Monday night. Max Shulga finished with 14 points and seven rebounds for the Rams (8-2). Phillip Russell hit two 3-pointers and scored nine. The Quakers (3-7) were led by Ethan Roberts with 14 points. Nick Spinoso contributed 12 points, seven rebounds, five assists and two steals. VCU took the lead with 5:28 left in the first half and never looked back. Bamisile led his team in scoring with 13 points in the first half to help put them up 36-25 at the break. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
